newsitem.title: USA: DuPont sees 1997 as "another strong year".
newsitem.headline: DuPont sees 1997 as "another strong year".

text.p: DuPont Co expects 1997 to be another strong year, Chief Executive John Krol said Wednesday.
The company reported record fourth quarter and full-year 1996 earnings, citing excellent petroleum refining and marketing performance and strong Chemicals and Specialties volumes in the second half.
"The double-digit Chemicals and Specialties volume growth in the fourth quarter gives us momentum moving into the new year," said Krol.
"Petroleum is also well positioned, given major refinery upgrades completed in 1996 and reasonably strong upstream market conditions.
"On balance, we expect 1997 to be another strong year."
